videos.title: Copilot Studio: Add Human Review to Your AI Agents
videos.description:
In this video we are going to build an agent that asks a human-in-the-loop to help make a decision. Because let’s face it, no matter how much planning we do, autonomous agents will encounter situations we never thought of. Or are too risky for an agent to decide alone.

With Copilot Studio an agent can send a message in teams or email, collect the response, and use it to steer the agent’s next action.

This is an important skill to learn so let's go build an agent together and see how its done.
